reasons: Support-role merits are outside Lens B.

residual_risks: Lens B did not independently test home-role support.

reasons: Holding/support merits are outside Lens B.
The lake treatment scope note matches the currency portion of the asserted holding: good law and overruled Twining and Adamson on this point.
residual_risks: Lens B did not perform quote-fidelity or holding-support review.

defect.problem: The good-law call itself matches the lake judgment fields, but the page's categorical 'No negative treatment' wording is too absolute because the disclosed treatment derivation contains audit-needed proposed negative hits, even though the listed edges are proposed and mention-only.
defect.proposed_fix: Keep field_i_validity as good_law, but tighten the prose to 'No confirmed negative treatment in the disclosed lake record; proposed mention-only treatment hits remain audit-flagged.'

reasons: Lake treatment field_i_validity is good_law as of 2026-06-30, varies_by_point is false, and point_overrides is empty.
All disclosed treatment edges are marked proposed=true and field_iii=mentioned, so they do not establish that Malloy has been overruled, abrogated, or superseded.
Derivation metadata nevertheless flags lane1_negative and lane2_top_cited audits as required, so absolute no-negative-treatment wording should be narrowed.
residual_risks: The disclosed record does not include full text for the proposed progeny hits, so the audit flag cannot be resolved further within this evidentiary universe.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Say no confirmed negative treatment, not no negative treatment.

reasons: Lake identity fields show court_id scotus and court_level scotus.
Lake treatment marks Malloy good_law, with no final disclosed override that would reduce its binding SCOTUS weight.
residual_risks: Weight review assumes the corpus uses SCOTUS decisions as binding unless a disclosed final treatment field changes that status.
